front_door.description: Main entrance not visible in these images. Street-facing access seen is a timber gate set in a high brick wall on the side elevation.

access_notes: High brick boundary wall to street with a narrow timber gate on the side elevation
Lamp post and short bollard positioned by the gate
Green street cabinet on pavement near the corner
No hydrant marker or standpipe plate observed
obstacles: Lamp post directly in front of the side gate
Short bollard next to the gate
Green utility/street cabinet near the corner
rear_access_note: Side gate in brick wall appears to lead to the side/rear garden. Satellite view shows a rear garden backing onto other gardens with no alley or open land.
parking: Kerbside on Elmwood Road adjacent to the property or on the side street at the corner if space is clear.
